[b]Canterlot: The city of 200 spires[/b]
Canterlot, nestled in the mountain country of Equestria, overlooking the hills of Equestria and further. It is sometimes said that on a clear day one can see the great central sea from the spire of St. Alvas Cathedral. The city of 1.2 million people with an area equal to that of prague is the heart of the dual monarchy and of the nation itself, if all roads lead to rome, then all roads lead to Canterlot. Once a small village at the base of the mountains, the city soon expanded beyond the small river valley it sat in spilling downstream from the river and onto the plains. Canterlot, the home of weavers, craftsmen and women, and hassling politicians.
